summary: Full backend + frontend testing completed for Tony Taxi Whistler V2.0. Backend pytest suite: 8/8 passed. Frontend Playwright: all critical flows pass — countdown, fare calculator ($299 Whistler→YVR), booking submission with confirmation + fare display, loyalty endpoint, FIFA cards (4), activities (12), floating CTAs (tel/wa/sms correct), FAQ accordion, nav scroll, mobile menu toggle.

minor.issue: Loyalty uses phone last-7-digit regex match without anchoring; could match unrelated bookings sharing the same last 7 digits. Low impact for MVP.
@app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; consider lifespan handlers.

issues: The Emergent badge + chat widgets overlap floating CTAs on mobile/desktop bottom-right; consider raising CTA stack above third-party widget z-index

action_items: Optional: anchor loyalty phone match to full normalized digits to avoid regex collisions
Optional: replace deprecated @app.on_event with FastAPI lifespan
Optional: ensure floating CTA z-index does not overlap third-party Emergent chat widget on small screens
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is concise (<250 lines) and well-structured; no MongoDB _id leak (excluded via projection).
Pydantic models validate all inputs; HTTP responses use correct status codes.
Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via process.env (confirmed by working fare/booking calls).
All interactive elements carry data-testid; great test coverage surface.
Loyalty filter only counts confirmed/completed — confirmed by behavior (frontend test phone with pending booking returned 0 rides as expected).
Note: backend has no rate limiting or input length caps; acceptable for MVP.
seed_data_creation: Test bookings created/cleaned in pytest fixtures (phones 7785551234, 7789998888). One frontend booking persisted with phone 7785559999 (status=pending, not affecting loyalty).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_tony_taxi.py covers root, fare-estimate (3 cases incl FIFA premium and 5+ surcharge), booking create+persist, list bookings sort, loyalty full flow (creates 2 bookings, confirms via direct mongo, verifies stamps=3), and testimonials (6). All flows work end-to-end against the public preview URL.
rca of the issue: No bugs found requiring RCA. All 14 requested test cases pass.
